integrity: Self-contained geometric proof and standalone numerical consistency program; no assertion of historical uniqueness or externally certified novelty.
limitations: Only Haar-uniform central sections, regular tetrahedra and exact distributions; no noisy-data stability or arbitrary tetrahedra. A later general width-density paper was available only in abstract, so historical priority of the joint result is provisional.
scientific_scope: Exact joint distribution of unit-edge regular tetrahedron width and the number of vertices of a uniformly oriented central plane section.
title: The joint width and central-section vertex-count law of a regular tetrahedron
